title: TypeInfo
description: What awl.facts reads statically from a LinkedBaseModel subclass. Both link declaration forms are first class; neither is canonical.

declared_types.description: Instance rdf:types, as written. From x-oold-instance-rdf-type when present, else the type field default. Under allOf the nearest declaration replaces rather than appends. The reference schemas write a bare term and let declared_context say what it resolves to, so this is an observation and awl.context reads it.

declared_context.description: The JSON-LD context the class declares for itself, in json_schema_extra. Present only when the class declares one. awl.context pulls it rather than deriving a second mapping from the annotations beside it, since the class is the authority on what its own fields mean. The array form is a context list, whose string entries are remote references and are not dereferenced.

target.description: Target type for a link; null for a literal field.

annotation.description: The annotation as written, e.g. float. Observation, not inference. awl.context derives the xsd:double coercion from it, without which an integer-valued float field round-trips through JSON-LD as xsd:integer. Named annotation and not pythonType because declarations already uses that name for the same thing, and because a language-specific key would contradict the neutral vocabulary.

arms.description: The value forms this field admits, per the OO-LD spec.
